name: Holding Cell
description: A damp stone cell with a slab bunk and a barred window set too high to reach. The only way out is a low arch to the north.

name: Guard Corridor
description: A long corridor of soot-black brick. A banded iron door blocks the way north, a watch post opens east, and a storeroom stands west.

name: Watch Post
description: A cramped guard nook: a stool, a cold brazier, and a shelf of kit nobody came back for.

name: Storeroom
description: Shelves of mildewed sacking. Whatever was worth stealing went long ago, but something small still hangs on a nail by the door.

name: Furnace Room
description: The great furnace ticks as it cools. Scalding steam hisses from a choked pipe that climbs toward the gallery above, and a stair drops west into standing water.

name: Flooded Cistern
description: Black water laps at the third step down. Supplies float where the flood left them, knocking softly against the wall.

name: Clockwork Gallery
description: Brass gears the size of cartwheels turn overhead, one of them missing a tooth. A reading room opens east, and a stair climbs north.

name: Records Room
description: Ledgers rot in their pigeonholes. A keyring still hangs behind the clerk's desk, forgotten by everyone who fled.

name: Antechamber
description: A vaulted hall before the outer gate. The gate is shut fast, and its lock is older than the prison built around it.

name: Courtyard
description: Open sky, wet cobbles, and an unguarded road past the gatehouse. You are out.
